why_selected_checkpoint_can_equal_anchor.answer: rl_pipeline_with_validation keeps a best-checkpoint history across epochs; the warm-start anchor's own evaluation (epoch-0/initial candidate) carries validation trades>0 from its original training, while every POST-anchor epoch fails the activity gate (trade_gate FAIL -> ineligible composite). Best-checkpoint selection therefore falls back to the anchor artifact, and the TERMINAL (last-epoch) weights are inactive. The selected 'best' is then indistinguishable from no learning unless terminal weights/hashes are inspected separately - which is why terminal_usable must never be inferred from best-checkpoint success.

raw_action_collapse_vs_threshold_rejecti.answer: distinguishing facts: (a) RAW policy output mean/std/min/max on fixed validation observations - if |raw| dispersion collapses toward 0 the policy itself collapsed; (b) thresholded action rate: bridge maps |raw| < continuous_action_threshold(=0.1) to HOLD, so raw dispersion > 0.1 with zero entries indicates threshold/order-path suppression, not policy collapse; (c) order submission/rejection counts (protected submissions vs rejections) separate order-path rejection from hold decisions. WP0 must report (a)+(b)+(c) per epoch; WP1 instruments them at the boundary.

direct_zero_margin_events_vs_unavailable.answer: gym-fx/app/bt_bridge.py maintains would_margin_call_events (line 59, reset line 85) and _continue_after_would_margin_call (line 230) records events with cause='would_margin_call' when easy-mode continuation replaces termination. DIRECT ZERO = the list exists in the run's diagnostics and is empty (len 0 observed). UNAVAILABLE = the diagnostics were never exported into the arm record (D1 case: margin/recapitalization telemetry absent from packets). The collector must type these differently and never coerce absence to 0.
